description: Side by side comparison of 1 to 5 entities: live TVL with 1d and 7d change, fees and revenue (DefiLlama), market cap and FDV (CoinGecko), plus BCA's tokenomics, audits, team and indicator rows. Each row lists its empty sections under missing, tokenomics last refreshed over 30 days ago under stale, and why a live section is empty under unavailable; partial when any row misses a section or has stale tokenomics, unseeded when no row has data. Pro tier.
name: compare_protocols
